put.description:
Edit assumptions.yaml. The next /v1/towfit/evaluate call uses the new values; no restart.

All edits in one request apply together or not at all. The file's comments are kept.
Past Decision Records keep the values they were evaluated with.

post.description:
Record what the operator actually did (deploy / wait for confirmation / dispatch wrecker), or an outcome.

Events are appended, never edited: the Decision Record and its events are an audit trail. The operator may act
differently from the recommendation; the summary reports whether they followed it.

Run the rule engine on the submitted fields and log a Decision Record.

TowFit does not replace operator judgment or authorize a move: the response is a recommendation, and the
operator's actual action is recorded separately with POST /v1/decisions/{id}/events.
